notes: PID Rakovnicko: okres Rakovník (licences 310xxx) and the PID lines whose first stop inwards from the outer end lies in it; PID GTFS of 1 Nov 2026, Monday 2 Nov 2026 (a school day). Every terminus is treated as a loop (typed = real − 1). The Prague-end lines 304, 305, 404, 415 and 417 are timed at both terminals; their Prague stops are on the Prague bus sheet. Most district lines are school-day lines of single trips, each bent onto one real afternoon round on one bus (every 120 to 480); six run every 480 (571, 572 Slabce, 573 Šípy, 574, 584 Vinařice, 711 Domoušice), each kept for stops no other line serves, inside or outside the kraj (owner, 2 Nov 2026: "Yes, serve every place"). The 0-minute turns at Hořovičky (573), Lhota pod Džbánem and Vinařice (584) and Domoušice, Solopysky (711 Domoušice) are modelled as in the timetable; this assumes the fork's automatic "Leave up to" lets a bus that arrives on the real minute leave although the loop rule types the departure 1 min early. Through-running seen in the timetable: 304 and 577 at Stochov, Slovanka II; 581 and 561 at Senomaty (modelled as 581 Senomaty). On the 2 Nov live map the 304 Rakovník – Zličín trips (13:20, 14:00, 15:30) go on from Zličín as the 305 of 15:05 to Karlovy Vary (13:20) and as the 404 of 15:40 and 17:40 to Kralovice (14:00, 15:30). Open: the other 304 ↔ 404 and 304 → 306 chains at Praha, Zličín; whether 561 Šamotka 14:10 → Kolešovice 15:26 goes on as 560 Kolešovice 15:30 (one circuit would save a bus); 562 → 561 at Rakovník, střelnice and 562 → 560 at the autobusové stanoviště. Lines 580 and 625 (Kladensko sheet) also serve Rakovník. The save holds one-convoy lines 100304 … 100760 for these numbers, without timetables.
